source_quotes: do not print the API key
overlap_check: Built-in method_5 (security) and method_47 (allowlist by argument) are general; method_48 covers registering an MCP. None states the credential matrix or the protected-list rule. New.

payload.name: Every Entry Point Names Its Credential and Protects Its Mutations
payload.description: Each route, tool and server says which credential admits it and what happens without one. A route that changes, approves, restores or deletes joins the protected list in the same change, and keys and tokens never leave their holder.

principles.name: Loopback is not authorization
principles.description: A localhost-only listener limits who can reach a route, not what a local process may do with it.

principles.name: No secret leaves
principles.description: A key or token is never printed, logged, returned or written to a note.

heuristics.condition: a mutating route is absent from the protected list
heuristics.action: list it as an open hardening gap and add it with an internal-caller path

heuristics.condition: a tool calls back into the host
heuristics.action: give it the shared internal header helper instead of an unauthenticated call

decision_rules.name: Name the credential
decision_rules.condition: a route, tool or server is added
decision_rules.outcome: state whether it is admitted by a session from the device-key challenge, the same-user internal token, a per-agent key, or loopback trust alone, and what it does without it

decision_rules.name: Protect mutations in the same change
decision_rules.condition: a route changes state, approves, overwrites, restores or erases
decision_rules.outcome: add its prefix to the strict-session protected list; make any exemption explicit, narrow and justified, such as a read-only check called by a spawned child with no session

decision_rules.name: Give internal callers a path first
decision_rules.condition: a route used by in-process callers is to be protected
decision_rules.outcome: give those callers the internal-token path before protecting it, so the host does not lock itself out

decision_rules.name: Bind identity to the process
decision_rules.condition: agents speak through an MCP server
decision_rules.outcome: bind one server process to one agent name and one key; an override is an explicit opt-in; a read-only switch refuses mutating tools

decision_rules.name: The UI never holds or fakes credentials
decision_rules.outcome: let the desktop main process hold the key and perform the real challenge; the renderer receives only success or an error; no development fallback fabricates authentication

decision_rules.name: Refuse host secrets
decision_rules.condition: a link or file path is supplied
decision_rules.outcome: refuse the data directory, config files, tokens, device keys, home credential folders and system paths; apply an optional allow-list of roots and resolve symlinks

decision_rules.name: Never expose a secret
decision_rules.condition: a key, token or credential is involved
decision_rules.outcome: never print, log, return or note it; scrub errors; flag and rotate one seen in output
